accuracy.definition: correct predictions divided by all evaluated samples

balanced_accuracy.definition: unweighted arithmetic mean of per-class recall over the frozen three-class order

confusion_matrix.definition: integer matrix with rows=true class and columns=predicted class in frozen order

macro_f1.definition: unweighted arithmetic mean of per-class F1 over the frozen three-class order

per_class_f1.definition: harmonic mean of per-class precision and recall

per_class_precision.definition: tp/(tp+fp) for each class in frozen order

per_class_recall.definition: tp/(tp+fn) for each class in frozen order
